const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function eeGetInfo(eeObj) {
  return await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    eeObj.getInfo((info) => resolve(info), (err) => reject(err));
  });
}

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const region = ee.Geometry.Point([45.203, 4.735]).buffer(30000); // 30 km
    const scale = 9000; // coarse scale to be efficient with ERA5-Land (~9 km native)
    const dataset = 'ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/DAILY';
    const band = 'volumetric_soil_water_layer_1';
    const may2017_start = '2017-05-01';
    const may2017_end = '2017-06-01';
    const may2018_start = '2018-05-01';
    const may2018_end = '2018-06-01';

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check
    function monthlyMean(colId, bandName, start, end) {
      const col = ee.ImageCollection(colId).filterDate(start, end).select(bandName);
      return { col: col, img: col.mean() };
    }

    let m2017 = monthlyMean(dataset, band, may2017_start, may2017_end);
    let size2017 = await eeGetInfo(m2017.col.size());
    if (size2017 === 0) {
      // widen a bit to try recover
      m2017 = monthlyMean(dataset, band, '2017-04-25', '2017-06-05');
      size2017 = await eeGetInfo(m2017.col.size());
    }
    let m2018 = monthlyMean(dataset, band, may2018_start, may2018_end);
    let size2018 = await eeGetInfo(m2018.col.size());
    if (size2018 === 0) {
      m2018 = monthlyMean(dataset, band, '2018-04-25', '2018-06-05');
      size2018 = await eeGetInfo(m2018.col.size());
    }

    console.log(`Region: Beledweyne (30km buffer), Scale: ${scale} m`);
    console.log(`Dataset: ${dataset}, Band: ${band}`);
    console.log(`May 2017 Images: ${size2017}`);
    console.log(`May 2018 Images: ${size2018}`);

    if (size2017 === 0 || size2018 === 0) {
      console.log('Empty collection for at least one period.');
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }

    // 3. Processing: compute mean and valid pixel count
    async function meanAndCount(img) {
      const meanDict = await eeGetInfo(
        img.reduceRegion({
          reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
          geometry: region,
          scale: scale,
          maxPixels: 1e9,
          bestEffort: true
        })
      );
      const countDict = await eeGetInfo(
        img.reduceRegion({
          reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
          geometry: region,
          scale: scale,
          maxPixels: 1e9,
          bestEffort: true
        })
      );
      return {
        mean: meanDict ? meanDict[band] : null,
        count: countDict ? countDict[band] : null
      };
    }

    const s2017 = await meanAndCount(m2017.img);
    const s2018 = await meanAndCount(m2018.img);

    if (!s2017.count || !s2018.count || s2017.count === 0 || s2018.count === 0) {
      console.log('No valid pixels after processing.');
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    const mean2017 = s2017.mean;
    const mean2018 = s2018.mean;

    const invalid =
      mean2017 === null || mean2018 === null ||
      !isFinite(mean2017) || !isFinite(mean2018) ||
      mean2017 < 0 || mean2018 < 0 || mean2017 > 1 || mean2018 > 1;

    console.log(`2017 Mean SM: ${mean2017 !== null ? mean2017.toFixed(4) : 'null'} (Pixels: ${s2017.count})`);
    console.log(`2018 Mean SM: ${mean2018 !== null ? mean2018.toFixed(4) : 'null'} (Pixels: ${s2018.count})`);

    if (invalid) {
      console.log('Invalid or null mean value(s).');
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    const diff = mean2018 - mean2017;
    console.log(`Diff (2018-2017): ${diff.toFixed(4)}`);

    // 5. Final Answer
    if (diff > 0) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${String(err).slice(0,180)}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
